topics.name: Biological and Medical uses of radiation
outcomes: Describe biological effects of radiation and explain the different medical uses of radiation.

topics.name: Reading comprehension, contextual/figurative language
outcomes: Scan to answer short questions
Deduce the meanings from context
Analyze how a writer/poet uses language to appeal to the senses through figurative language

units.name: 2. Formal and Lexical Aspect of Language

topics.name: Vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure
outcomes: Deduce the meaning of difficult words from the context using contextual clues.
Explore the use of synonyms with varying shades of meaning used for irony, parody and satire.
Illustrate use of pronoun-antecedent agreement.
Illustrate use of tenses.
Illustrate use of infinitives and infinitive phrases.
Illustrate the use of gerunds and gerund phrases.
Recognize varying position of adverbs in sentences according to their kinds and importance.
Illustrate use of prepositions of position, time, movement and direction.
Use appropriate transitional devices in speech and writing.
Illustrate use of all punctuation marks wherever applicable.
Analyze sentences for different classes and phrases, and evaluate how their position changes meaning and communicative function.
Recognize and use sentence inversion for various purposes.
Use active and passive voice appropriately according to the required communicative function.
Use direct and indirect speech appropriately according to the required communicative function.

topics.name: Proofreading and editing
outcomes: Proofread and edit their own, peers', and given text for errors of usage and style.
Identify faulty sentence structure
Identify subject-verb agreement errors
Identify errors of function words and spelling

topics.name: Evaluating truth and reasonableness of beliefs
outcomes: Develop logical arguments for statements to be true or false.
Give reasons for the right beliefs.
Identify and critically evaluate false beliefs using logical reasoning.

topics.name: Sequential order of letters, numbers or both
outcomes: Develop arithmetical operations as per numbers.
Develop geometrical progression as per numbers.
Develop series/sequential orders as per letters and symbols (according to specific rules).

topics.name: Structured thinking to deduce accurate responses
outcomes: Predict new relations on the basis of given relations.
Develop new structures on the basis of information in already drawn structures.

topics.name: Puzzles requiring deductive reasoning
outcomes: Infer the result of one problem to resolve another problem.
Develop skills to solve puzzles.

topics.name: Administrative decisions based on given information
outcomes: Develop skills to gather different parts of information.
Use information for making decisions.
Judge different courses of action by using arguments.

topics.name: Relationship between events and their causes
outcomes: Give reasons for incidents/events and accidents.
Reject false beliefs through valid arguments.
Build positive thinking in society through strong arguments.
